editorial_thesis: The most useful agent progress today is boundary work: choose the right local or hosted model, constrain execution on the developer machine, and catch secrets with a purpose-built detector before they become durable incidents.

topic_groups.title: Local Model Choice + Provider Portability
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh GitHub CLI support makes local Ollama models visible inside an active agent session; this fills a practical portability gap after yesterday's private retrieval coverage.

sources.title: Discover local models in GitHub Copilot CLI
sources.why_selected: Copilot CLI 1.0.94-0 can discover tool-capable models from a running Ollama instance.
sources.usefulness: Test local routing without rebuilding the agent workflow.

sources.title: GitHub Copilot CLI provider and offline-mode docs
sources.why_selected: The docs clarify provider configuration and the limits of offline mode.
sources.usefulness: Prevent a local-model assumption from becoming a data-egress mistake.

sources.title: Ollama
sources.why_selected: The local runtime is the concrete dependency behind the new discovery path.
sources.usefulness: Run a bounded local model trial on a real workstation.

sources.title: Copilot CLI releases
sources.why_selected: Versioning matters because discovery starts at CLI 1.0.94-0.
sources.usefulness: Pin and reproduce the exact client/runtime combination.

sources.title: GitHub local development announcement
sources.why_selected: GitHub links the feature to intelligent routing with local models.
sources.usefulness: Watch for routing policy details before standardizing the pattern.

topic_groups.title: Agent Execution Boundaries
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Local sandboxing reached general availability across Copilot surfaces, turning agent autonomy into a machine-enforced policy problem rather than a prompt-writing exercise.

sources.title: Local sandboxing for GitHub Copilot now generally available
sources.why_selected: Sandbox policies now constrain filesystem, network, credentials, and local tools.
sources.usefulness: Translate client agent pilots into explicit allowlists and deny paths.

sources.title: Microsoft eXecution Container
sources.why_selected: MXC provides a common policy translated into native controls on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
sources.usefulness: Inspect the policy substrate instead of treating sandboxing as a black box.

sources.title: Cloud and local sandboxes documentation
sources.why_selected: The docs define configuration and enterprise enforcement surfaces.
sources.usefulness: Create a deployment checklist for local and cloud agent modes.

sources.title: GitHub Copilot app model providers
sources.why_selected: Model choice and tool isolation are separate controls.
sources.usefulness: Keep provider selection from weakening execution policy.

sources.title: Copilot CLI
sources.why_selected: The CLI is a concrete surface for testing the boundary with terminal tasks.
sources.usefulness: Run a harmless filesystem/network canary before broader rollout.

topic_groups.title: Secret Detection at the Boundary
topic_groups.selection_rationale: GitHub shipped a detector designed for contextual and unstructured credentials, with separate included and credit-consuming paths; this is a useful supply-chain lane distinct from yesterday's transport check.

sources.title: Purpose-built model for leaked secret detection
sources.why_selected: The model uses surrounding code to detect credentials that token-pattern rules miss.
sources.usefulness: Add a pre-push control for agent-generated configuration and prose.

sources.title: GitHub Secret Protection
sources.why_selected: Secret Protection is the licensing and policy context for included AI alerts.
sources.usefulness: Separate entitlement, enablement, and observed coverage in a scorecard.

sources.title: GitHub Advanced Security
sources.why_selected: The security platform connects secret scanning with broader code-scanning workflows.
sources.usefulness: Place agent security review inside an existing control plane.

sources.title: GitHub AI usage insights
sources.why_selected: Preview push protection and security-review checks consume AI Credits.
sources.usefulness: Budget the new checks before enabling them across high-volume repos.

sources.title: GitHub security overview
sources.why_selected: Portfolio-level visibility makes control state reportable.
sources.usefulness: Track enabled, configured, observed, and remediated—not just alert counts.
